text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer can identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects in an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in daily life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to recognize roads, traffic signs, and pedestrians. It also helps doctors examine medical images and helps phones unlock with face recognition. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more powerful and useful.
